blocks.text: Dekha gaya hai ke jin nuclei ka atomic number 82 se zyada ho woh naturally (qudrati taur par) unstable hote hain aur khud ba khud (spontaneously) radiations emit karte (nikalte) hain. Aise nuclei ko radioactive kehte hain aur radiation ke is emission (nikalne) ko natural radioactivity. Yeh radiations teen qism ki hain: α-particles, β-particles aur γ-radiations. Unstable isotopes lab mein nuclear reactions se artificially (masnoo'i taur par, insaan ke banaye) bhi banaye ja sakte hain: kisi stable element par neutrons, protons, alpha particles ya gamma rays jaise zyada energy wale particles maare jayein to woh unstable ho kar radiation nikalne lagta hai. Isay artificial radioactivity kehte hain, aur radioactive isotopes ko radioisotopes ya radionuclides.

Electric field mein se guzarne par α, β aur γ alag alag raste lete hain (Fig. 12.4). α-particles negative plate ki taraf mudte hain, yani un par positive charge hai. α-particles bohat tez nikalte hain, aam taur par roshni ki speed ke kuch percent, magar bhaari hone ki wajah se hawa mein sirf kuch centimetre tak ja pate hain. β-particles positive plate ki taraf mudte hain, yani un par negative charge hai. β ka mudna α se zyada hai, jo prove karta hai ke β, α se halke hain. β-particles tez chalte electrons hain jin ki speed roshni ki speed ke 0.9995 guna tak hoti hai. γ-radiations field se bina mude guzar jati hain, yani un par charge nahi. γ-radiations photons se bani electromagnetic radiation hain; yeh roshni ki speed se chalti hain, in ki penetrating power (cheezon ke andar ghusne ki taaqat) sab se zyada aur ionization power (atoms ko ion banane ki taaqat) sab se kam hai.

blocks.alt: Radioactive substance (maadda) lead ke block mein ek cavity (khaane) ke sire par rakha hai. Is ki radiation ek beam (patli dhaar) ban kar nikalti hai aur do charged plates ke darmiyan se guzarti hai, oopar + aur neeche -. Plates ke baad beam teen hisson mein bant jati hai: beta rays + plate ki taraf zyada murti hain, gamma rays seedhi jati hain aur alpha rays - plate ki taraf thora murti hain; teeno photographic plate tak pohanchti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.4: Teen radioactive radiations, alpha, beta aur gamma (kitab ki Figure 12.4 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: lead block, radioactive substance, electrically charged plates, photographic plate, beta rays, gamma rays aur alpha rays. Beta ka rasta naranji, gamma ka jamni aur alpha ka hara hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Lead ka block radiation ko har taraf se rokta hai, is liye radiation sirf cavity (khaane) ke munh se ek seedhi beam ban kar nikalti hai. Charged plates ke darmiyan beta particles negative hone ki wajah se + plate ki taraf murte hain, alpha particles positive hone ki wajah se - plate ki taraf murte hain, aur gamma rays par koi charge nahi, is liye woh seedhi jati hain. Beta ka deflection (mur jana) alpha se kahin zyada hai kyun ke beta (electron) bohat halka hai aur alpha bhaari. Photographic plate par teen alag nishaan is baat ka saboot hain ke radiation teen qism ki hai.
Nucleus se α-particles, β-particles aur γ-radiations nikalne ke process ko α-decay, β-decay aur γ-decay kehte hain. Neeche in ko samjhaya gaya hai.
Alpha Decay

Kitab ke mutabiq jab nucleus mein protons ka electrostatic repulsion (aapas mein dhakelna) strong nuclear force ki attraction (kheenchne) se zyada ho jaye to nucleus unstable ho kar alpha particles nikalta hai. (Kitab ki is line mein ghalti hai, neeche box dekhein.) α-particle helium (He) ka nucleus hai: 2 protons aur 2 neutrons. Yani α-decay mein nucleus 2 protons aur 2 neutrons kho deta hai: atomic number Z do kam aur mass number A chaar kam ho jata hai. General (aam) form:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke jab nucleus mein protons neutrons se zyada hon to alpha decay hota hai. Yeh sahi nahi: alpha nikalne wale nuclei bhaari hote hain aur un mein neutrons protons se zyada hote hain (radium-226 mein 88 protons aur 138 neutrons). Asal wajah yeh hai ke bohat bare nucleus mein bohat se protons ka electrostatic repulsion poore nucleus par asar karta hai, jabke strong nuclear force sirf paas paas ke nucleons ke darmiyan lagti hai; is liye aisa nucleus unstable ho kar alpha particle nikalta hai.

Yahan ᴬ_Z X parent (asal) nucleus hai jo daughter (naye) nucleus ᴬ⁻⁴_(Z−2) X mein badalta hai, aur ⁴₂He alpha particle hai (kitab daughter ko bhi X likhti hai, halanke yeh naya element hai). Experiments se pata hai ke α-decay mein nucleons ki tadaad (A) aur electric charge dono conserve (barqarar) rehte hain. Misal:
Radium-226 (²²⁶₈₈Ra) ek alpha particle nikal kar radon-222 (²²²₈₆Rn) ban jata hai.

blocks.alt: Parent nucleus radium-226 (A = 226, Z = 88) nucleons ke guchhe ki shakal mein hai. Is se ek dashed teer chhote alpha particle, helium-4 (A = 4, Z = 2), tak jata hai aur doosra dashed teer neeche daughter nucleus radon-222 (A = 222, Z = 86) tak.
blocks.caption: Radium-226 ka alpha decay: parent nucleus, alpha particle aur daughter nucleus radon-222 (kitab mein Equation 12.3 ke saath bani bina caption wali sketch ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Radium-226 ka nucleus apne andar se 2 protons aur 2 neutrons ka ek guchha, yani alpha particle (helium-4), bahar phenkta hai. Peeche jo nucleus bachta hai woh radon-222 hai: mass number 226 - 4 = 222 aur atomic number 88 - 2 = 86. Dono teeron ke numbers jor kar dekhein: 222 + 4 = 226 aur 86 + 2 = 88, yani nucleons ki tadaad aur charge dono conserve rehte hain.

Is reaction mein daughter nucleus (²²²₈₆Rn) parent nucleus (²²⁶₈₈Ra) se alag element hai. Ek element ka doosre element mein badalna transmutation kehlata hai. Experiments se pata hai ke parent nucleus ka mass daughter nucleus aur α-particle ke total mass se zyada hota hai. Is liye decay ke baad bani cheezon ki total mass-energy (E = mc²) asal nuclide se kam hoti hai. Mass-energy ka yeh farq disintegration energy Q, ya decay ki Q-value, kehlata hai; yahi energy alpha particle aur daughter ko kinetic energy ki shakal mein milti hai.
Beta Decay
β-decay do qism ka hai: beta-minus decay aur beta-plus decay.
(i) β⁻-Decay

Jin nuclides mein neutron-to-proton ratio (N/P) bohat zyada ho, woh β⁻-decay karte hain. β-particles atom ke bahar ghoomne wale (orbital) electrons nahi; yeh nikalne ke waqt nucleus ke andar bante hain. Is process mein nucleus ka ek neutron toot kar proton aur electron ban jata hai, aur saath ek aur particle, antineutrino, nikalta hai jo neutrino ka anti-particle hai. Neutrino ka symbol Greek letter ν (nu) aur antineutrino ka ν̄ hai. Process yeh hai:

Ek neutron proton ban jata hai aur charge conserve rakhne ke liye ek electron nikalta hai; inhein beta particles kehte hain, aur inhein orbital electrons se alag pehchana nahi ja sakta. Neutrino aur antineutrino dono par charge zero aur mass bohat kam hai, is liye matter se guzarte hue inhein detect karna (pakarna) bohat mushkil hai. β-particle nikalne se koi nucleon kam nahi hota: mass number A wahi rehta hai aur atomic number Z ek barh jata hai. General form:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke 'nucleons ki total tadaad A wahi rehti hai magar mass number Z badalta hai'. Yahan lafz ghalat hai: A mass number hai aur Z atomic number. Beta-minus decay mein mass number A wahi rehta hai aur atomic number Z ek barh jata hai.

blocks.text_alt: ᴬ_Z X → ᴬ_(Z+1) X + ⁰₋₁e + ν̄

blocks.text: Is se saaf hai ke atomic number Z wala parent element atomic number (Z + 1) wale element mein badal jata hai. Misal: thorium ka ek unstable isotope beta nikal kar protactinium ban jata hai (aam misal ²³⁴₉₀Th → ²³⁴₉₁Pa; kitab baen taraf sirf A aur Z likhti hai):

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: Neutrino ka idea sab se pehle Wolfgang Pauli ne 1930 mein diya taa ke beta-minus aur beta-plus decays mein energy ki conservation poori ho. Kitab ke mutabiq 1953 mein F. Reines aur C. L. Cowan ne isay ek bohat taaqatwar nuclear reactor mein detect kiya (un ka pakka experiment 1956 mein publish hua). Is discovery par F. Reines ko 1995 mein Nobel Prize mila.
(ii) β⁺-Decay

Kuch nuclides mein neutron-to-proton ratio (N/P) stable rehne ke liye bohat kam hota hai; yeh electron ki jagah positron nikalte hain. Positron (e⁺) ka mass electron jitna magar charge positive hai; yeh electron ka anti-particle hai. Is process mein nucleus ka ek proton neutron aur positron ban jata hai, aur saath ek neutrino nikalta hai. General form:

blocks.text_alt: ᴬ_Z X → ᴬ_(Z−1) X + ⁰₊₁e + ν

blocks.text: Misal: neon positron aur neutrino nikal kar fluorine ban jata hai (kitab mein 'Flourine' chhapa hai):
Energy of Alpha and Beta Particles in Radioactive Decay

Kisi ek radionuclide ke α-decay aur β-decay, dono mein har dafa utni hi energy nikalti hai. Kisi radionuclide ke α-decay mein har α-particle ki kinetic energy bilkul fixed (sharply defined, pakki) hoti hai. α-particles ki tadaad ko kinetic energy ke muqable mein graph par banayein to alag alag spikes (khari lakeerein) aati hain (Fig. 12.5). Yani α-particles ki energies discrete (alag alag, fixed) hain.

blocks.alt: Alpha particles ki tadaad (N) aur kinetic energy (eV) ka graph. Curve ki bajaye is mein alag oonchai ki chaar alag vertical (khari) lakeerein (spikes) khaas energies par hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.5: Alpha particles ki discrete (alag alag) energy values (kitab ki Figure 12.5 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: β-decay mein energy β-particle aur antineutrino ke darmiyan har baar alag hisson mein bant-ti hai; magar dono ki energy ka jor hamesha wahi rehta hai. Is liye β-decay mein electron ya positron ki energy zero se le kar ek maximum (zyada se zyada) value tak kuch bhi ho sakti hai. β-particles ki tadaad ko kinetic energy ke muqable mein banayein to continuous (bina toote) curve banta hai (Fig. 12.6). Yani beta particles ki energies continuous range mein hain. Alpha aur beta dono mein momentum aur energy ki conservation lagu hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Beta particles ki tadaad (N) aur kinetic energy (eV) ka graph. Ek smooth continuous curve vertical axis par thora oopar se shuru hota hai, kam energy par peak (choti) tak jata hai, phir girta hua sab se zyada energy par zero tak pohanch jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.6: Beta particles ka continuous (bina toota) spectrum (kitab ki Figure 12.6 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono graphs ko compare karein (milayein). Figure 12.5 mein sirf kuch khaas energies par alag lakeerein hain: alpha particles fixed (discrete) energies ke saath nikalte hain, aur beech ki energies par koi alpha particle nahi milta. Figure 12.6 mein curve zero se maximum energy tak bina toote chalta hai: beta decay mein energy beta particle aur antineutrino (ya neutrino) mein har baar alag hisson mein bant-ti hai, is liye beta particle ki energy is range mein kuch bhi ho sakti hai. Curve ka aakhri sira woh maximum energy hai jo beta particle ko tab milti hai jab neutrino ko taqreeban kuch nahi milta.
(iii) Gamma Radiation
Nucleus se γ-radiation ka nikalna aam taur par yun likha jata hai:

blocks.text_alt: ᴬ_Z X* → ᴬ_Z X + γ radiation

blocks.text: Yahan ᴬ_Z X* excited (zyada energy wala) nucleus aur ᴬ_Z X us ki ground state (sab se kam energy wali halat) hai; A aur Z nahi badalte, sirf extra energy γ photon ki shakal mein nikal jati hai.

blocks.text: Short summary (mukhtasar khulasa)

items: Natural radioactivity: Z 82 se zyada wale nuclei α, β aur γ nikalte hain; artificial radioactivity radioisotopes banati hai. Electric field mein α negative plate ki taraf thora, β positive plate ki taraf zyada mudta hai, γ bilkul nahi.

Alpha: Z − 2, A − 4 (²²⁶₈₈Ra → ²²²₈₆Rn + ⁴₂He); transmutation; Q-value. Beta-minus: n → p + e⁻ + ν̄, Z + 1. Beta-plus: Z − 1 (¹⁹₁₀Ne → ¹⁹₉F + e⁺ + ν). Gamma: X* → X + γ. Alpha energies discrete, beta continuous. Table 12.2 teenon ka comparison (muqabla).
